title: When the Crown Burns
premise: Dominic Sterling has buried his magical past beneath twenty years of harmless trinkets in Vellharrow, a city where the Practice is punishable by burning. When a mute child arrives at his shop speaking the Old Tongue, Dominic recognizes the language of his dead mistress—and the child as a soul-fragment sold decades ago to the Court Beneath the Mountain, a bargain his mistress made to save his own life. To free the child, Dominic must reclaim that debt, descending into a court that feeds on inherited obligations and discovering that his survival was the currency all along. He ends the bargain by surrendering his stolen years to the child, who wakes as his mistress's true heir while Dominic, finally ordinary, walks out of the mountain alive.
about_author: Zephyrine Coldharbour is the pen name of a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing debt-ledgers from defunct noble houses before turning to fiction. She writes fantasy about bargains, inheritance, and the people who survive them.
